title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — Recovery, Carryforward and Write-Off Terms by Tier
content:
Terms of recovery on the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan. Early wage transfers and their fees are recovered on payday; these tier terms govern how recovery is collected and how long an unrecovered amount may stand.

| Tier | Recovery method on payday | Card autorecovery allowed | Card autorecovery delay (business days after the payday) | Card autorecovery debits per payday's shortfall | Later paydays an unrecovered amount may be carried to | Write-off wait (calendar days after the payday) | Voluntary early repayment allowed | Smallest voluntary payment | Partial payroll deduction allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | payroll deduction | yes | 1 | 1 | 1 | 30 | yes | 1.00 USD | yes |
| Paystride Access Standard | payroll deduction | yes | 1 | 1 | 1 | 30 | yes | 1.00 USD | yes |
| Paystride Access Plus | payroll deduction | yes | 1 | 1 | 2 | 30 | yes | 1.00 USD | yes |
| Paystride Access Preferred | payroll deduction | yes | 2 | 1 | 2 | 30 | yes | 1.00 USD | yes |
| Paystride Access Premier | payroll deduction | yes | 2 | 1 | 2 | 30 | yes | 1.00 USD | yes |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | payroll deduction | yes | 2 | 1 | 3 | 30 | yes | 1.00 USD | yes |

## Definitions

- **Recovery method** — the method by which advances are recovered on payday; on every tier it is the employer's payroll deduction.
- **Card autorecovery allowed** — whether an unrecovered amount may be debited from the worker's Paystride Visa Payroll Card under a standing authorization.
- **Card autorecovery delay** — the business days after the payday on which a card autorecovery debit is attempted.
- **Card autorecovery debits per shortfall** — the card autorecovery debits attempted for one payday's shortfall.
- **Carryforward** — the number of later paydays to which an unrecovered amount may be carried before it is written off.
- **Write-off wait** — the calendar days after the payday of a shortfall that will not be carried before it is written off, leaving time for card autorecovery or a voluntary payment.
- **Voluntary early repayment** — whether the worker may repay an outstanding amount early from their own funds.
- **Smallest voluntary payment** — the smallest voluntary payment the worker may make, unless the outstanding balance is smaller.
- **Partial payroll deduction** — whether the employer deducts the part of the amount due that net pay can cover when net pay cannot cover all of it.

## Points of reading

The carryforward reach grows with the tier: one later payday on the two lower tiers, two on Paystride Access Plus, Paystride Access Preferred and Paystride Access Premier, and three on Paystride Access Premier Plus. The card autorecovery delay is one business day up to Paystride Access Plus and two from Paystride Access Preferred upward. The 30-day write-off wait, the single card debit per shortfall and the 1.00 USD voluntary minimum hold on every tier.
